title: Fix mixed-currency totals in Close Income Statement
summary: Fixed the Close Income Statement report to correctly process mixed-currency GL entries that were previously duplicated or omitted when source-currency groups were interleaved, and added comprehensive regression tests.
key_points: Fixed grouped calculations to process each filtered GL entry group once instead of skipping by count
Added regression test coverage for Balance closing with and without global dimensions
Added third-close regression test for historical closing entries with blank source-currency metadata
Propagated fixes to ES and IT localized versions
quote: Fixed grouped calculations to process each filtered G/L entry group once instead of skipping rows by count.
